excerpt: Rapport annuel (Annual Securities Report, traduction anglaise) de Nintendo pour l'exercice clos le 31/03/2026, conseil d'administration au 25/06/2026 : « 10 male Directors and four female Directors (percentage of women: 28.6%) »

Rapport annuel (Annual Securities Report, traduction anglaise) de Nintendo pour l'exercice clos le 31/03/2026, conseil d'administration : « The Board of Directors consists of fourteen Directors (including five Directors who are Audit and Supervisory Committee Members), of whom seven are Outside Directors » ; « The six Outside Directors excluding Mr. Chris Meledandri have been appointed as independent officers as stipulated by Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc » ; calcul : 6 / 14 = 42,9 % (administrateurs indépendants).

Rapport annuel (Annual Securities Report, traduction anglaise) de Canon pour l'exercice 2025, déposé le 25/03/2026, conseil d'administration : « As of the date of submission of this report, the Board of Directors consists of 10 members, 6 internal members of which 3 are Representative Directors, and 4 Independent Outside Directors » ; calcul : 4 / 10 = 40 % (administrateurs indépendants).

Rapport annuel (Annual Securities Report, traduction anglaise) de Brother Industries pour l'exercice clos le 31/03/2026, conseil d'administration : « five of the Company’s 10 Directors are Outside Directors as of the filing date of this Annual Securities Report (June 22, 2026) » ; « The Company has also reported to the Tokyo Stock Exchange and Nagoya Stock Exchange all the Outside Directors and Outside Auditors as independent officers specified by each Exchange » ; calcul : 5 / 10 = 50 % (administrateurs indépendants).
